second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 14 + Average 6 + Difficulty 4 = 24), pdf 55; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-24 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates. BLUE PRINT 14/6/4 = 24 = audited count. Answer side 'Sample Answers: 14' prints keys 1-16 for another version of the questions; only key 6 matches its printed question by number and content. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 24.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 55 (heading, LO 6, BLUE PRINT, q1-5) 56 (q6-11, box) 57 (q12-17 + q16's four pictures) 58 (q17 table, q18, q19 a-c) 59 (q19 d-e, q20-24). A side 'Sample Answers: 14' pdf 115 (keys 1-16, below the end of Lesson 13's keys). Folios = pdf page.

KEY SIDE: see reports/class-3-evs/evs-3-14-18_key-side_analysis.md. Paired by number: q6 <- key 6 only. Empty + 'key belongs to another paper version' with content pointers: q7 <- 5, q16 <- 4 (partial), q19 <- 7-11, q20-22 <- 12-14, q23 <- 15, q24 <- 16. q17, q18: no key ('no answer printed').

Sections (-sN- by printed order; numbered stand-alone questions with their own header are their own section, as evs-3-02 q18): s1 I match q1-4; s2 II q5-8; s3 III riddles q9-11; s4 IV fill-from-box q12-15; s5 q16; s6 q17; s7 q18; s8 q19; s9 V yes/no q20-22 (open personal answers -> vsa); s10 VI q23-24.
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): s1 1, s2 1, s3 1, s4 1, s9 1, s10 2; null where N disagrees with the printed count (s5 '4*1=4', s6 '5*1=5', s7 '5*1=5', s8 '5X1=5', each over 1 question).
FIGURES (v1.4 §14.10): q16 four vehicle pictures (pdf 57) and q19 five worker pictures (pdf 58-59) -> stimuli with one crop per picture (D4 path images/evs-3-14/stimuli/).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 24 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 6, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
PARKED (R-E8; T-E1 extended to match): empty match answers q1-q4 cannot pass gate 2.20. Built in the work dir with its crops; not committed.
